findings.issue: The analyst model only rejects releases after `window_end`. An estimate dated before `window_start` is projected from its release through the end of summer, allowing an ineligible pre-window film to enter the simulated top ten. This violates the load-bearing rule that films released before the window contribute nothing.
findings.suggestion: Return `(0.0, 0.0)` when `release_date` falls outside the inclusive wager window, and test April 30 versus May 1.

findings.issue: Pre-opening estimate title keys are not validated as strings. A numeric YAML key is accepted here, added to the candidate set, and later causes `sorted(candidates)` to fail when mixed with normal string titles, violating boundary validation.
findings.suggestion: Require the document and each entry to be mappings and every title key to be a non-empty string before constructing `PreopeningEstimate` objects.

findings.issue: Direct-label collision handling only pushes labels downward without respecting the SVG bounds. When several leading players have low or equal odds, labels are moved below the 300px viewBox and become clipped or invisible.
findings.suggestion: Lay labels out within the plot bounds, shifting upward when necessary or using a bounded collision-resolution pass.
